description: This file defines a ProfilerListener class that implements the EventSubscriberInterface to handle Symfony kernel events. It hooks into request, controller, response, terminate, and exception events to manage profiling data, modify responses for debugging purposes, and track redirections.

classes.name: ProfilerListener
classes.description: Implements event handling for Symfony kernel events to profile and modify responses, and track redirections.

methods.name: onKernelRequest
methods.description: Handles the kernel.request event to add the event to the profiler.

methods.name: onKernelController
methods.description: Handles the kernel.controller event to add the event to the profiler.

methods.name: onKernelResponse
methods.description: Handles the kernel.response event, injecting debug content into HTML responses and recording redirections.

methods.name: onKernelTerminate
methods.description: Placeholder for handling the kernel.terminate event.

methods.name: onKernelException
methods.description: Placeholder for handling the kernel.exception event.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping Symfony kernel events to handler methods with priorities.
